options: Allows flow in one direction only
Cools the liquid as it passes
Reduces the pressure downstream
Controls flow rate with a hand wheel
questions.explanation: Also called a check valve. It stops backflow.

options: Air trapped at the top of a tank
Corrosion from sea water in the pipe
A leak at a flange under pressure
A pressure shock from suddenly stopping flow
questions.explanation: Close valves slowly and avoid sudden flow changes to prevent damaged pipes.

questions.stem: Why must tank vents be clear when filling or pumping out a tank?
options: To reduce fuel cost by cutting losses
To prevent over-pressure or vacuum in the tank
To warm the liquid as it fills the tank
To let the crew sound the tank down through the vent
questions.explanation: Blocked vents can rupture or collapse a tank.

questions.stem: Steel pipe carrying a hot fluid will:
options: Shrink in length as it heats up
Stay exactly the same length
Become magnetic as it warms
Expand in length, so allow for it
questions.explanation: Expansion bends or joints allow for movement.

questions.stem: A cross connection in a piping system is a hazard because it can:
options: Make the pipes lighter and easier to fit
Let fluid go where it is not meant to, such as the wrong tank
Improve cooling by mixing hot and cold lines
Remove the need for valves at each tank
questions.explanation: Always check the valve line-up before pumping.

questions.stem: A gate valve is best used:
options: To regulate flow finely
As a non-return valve
As a pressure relief valve
Fully open or fully closed
questions.explanation: Partly open, a gate valve is damaged by the flow. Use a globe valve for regulating.

questions.stem: A vacuum gauge on a pump is normally fitted:
options: On the discharge side
On the radiator cap
On the exhaust
On the suction side
questions.explanation: It shows pressure below atmospheric, as in a suction line.

questions.stem: A fresh water accumulator tank that makes the pump start and stop rapidly is probably:
options: Perfectly normal for that size of tank
Waterlogged, with its air charge lost
Missing a thermostat on the outlet
Too large for the pump fitted
questions.explanation: The air cushion absorbs pressure changes. Without it the pump cycles often.

questions.stem: A bilge suction pipe ends in a strum box to:
options: Keep rubbish out of the pump
Increase pressure at the suction
Stop air entering the pipe
Measure the bilge water level
questions.explanation: A blocked strum box is a common cause of lost suction.

questions.stem: When bringing a hot liquid line into service you should:
options: Run it dry first to check for leaks
Warm it gradually and open the drains
Close the vents and drains to hold heat
Open the valves quickly to save time
questions.explanation: Gradual heating and draining prevent water hammer and thermal shock.
